summary: Post-deployment-check regression verification for KIZILKAN PLAYER v4.0.0. Confirmed NO regression since iteration 6. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases PASSED (health, M3U, Xtream, Stalker, EPG, DVR). Frontend: /onboarding route loads correctly (no playlists state), animated splash + neon KIZILKAN branding rendered, no red-screens, no page errors, metro bundle compiles cleanly (~40ms bundle time). `expo` and `backend` supervisor services are RUNNING. /api/health returns {status:ok, db:connected}. The deployment_agent finding about missing `--tunnel` flag is a FALSE POSITIVE for containerized web preview + eas build APK workflow — confirmed the app works perfectly without it. App is ready for Publish/APK build.
action_items: None. App is regression-free and safe to Publish. The deployment_agent --tunnel finding can be safely ignored (READONLY platform file, and --tunnel is only for Expo Go dev tunneling, not APK builds via EAS).
critical_code_review_comments: React Native web console warnings observed (textShadow*/shadow*/pointerEvents deprecations, useNativeDriver JS fallback) — these are WEB-ONLY informational notices and do NOT affect native APK/IPA builds. No action required.
seed_data_creation: None. DVR tests create+delete TEST_ prefixed data (self-cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 confirms iteration 6 result is stable. Backend 22/22 green, frontend loads /onboarding cleanly on empty state. Supervisor services healthy. No --tunnel flag required for the containerized preview or EAS APK build workflow.
rca_of_issue: Deployment_agent flagged missing `--tunnel` on expo start in /etc/supervisor/conf.d/supervisord.conf. RCA: false positive. `--tunnel` starts an ngrok tunnel for Expo Go remote device access during dev, and is orthogonal to (a) the containerized web preview that already exposes port 3000 via the Emergent proxy and (b) EAS Build which produces APK/IPA independent of `expo start` config. The supervisor file is also marked READONLY and platform-managed. Verified empirically: app works fine without --tunnel.
